0:33 Tanahnya

3:29 Keputusan Belanda
4:36 Memindahkan orang dari Jawa
5:56 Yang sebenarnya memperlambat Jawa

items.judul: Why Half of Indonesia Lives on One Island
items.deskripsi:
After watching, you can explain why more than half of Indonesia lives on Java, and why 75 years of moving people off the island barely changed that.

0:00 One island, 158 million people
0:33 The ground
2:13 A field that pays for more hands
3:29 The Dutch decision
4:36 Moving people off Java
5:56 What actually slowed Java
7:11 Why the crowd stays
7:46 Back to the fridge
